prompt: We need to shut down an old workspace conversation. Can you archive the private channel that has both Priya and Sophie as members?
binding_note: Both membership conditions (Priya and Sophie each holding a CONVERSATION_MEMBERSHIP record) must bind to the same conversation, and that conversation must also carry is_private=true; no seeded conversation satisfies all three conditions together.

roles.facts: D01AGENTSOPHIE is private (is_private=true, is_dm=true) with members U01AGENBOT9 and U_SOPHIE only.
roles.reason: Satisfies the private flag and has Sophie as a member, but Priya is never a member of this conversation — missing relationship for one of the two required people.

roles.facts: C_INFRA (core-infra) has both U_PRIYA and U_SOPHIE as conversation members, but is_private is false (a public channel).
roles.reason: Both membership conditions hold on the same conversation, but the private-channel condition fails — wrong attribute value on the same record.

roles.facts: C_MODEL has both U_PRIYA and U_SOPHIE as members, is_private=false.
roles.reason: Same failure mode as core-infra: both people are members but the channel is public, not private.

roles.facts: C_GROWTH has both U_PRIYA and U_SOPHIE as members, is_private=false.
roles.reason: Another public channel with both people as members, again failing the private-channel requirement.

roles.facts: C_FRONTEND has both U_PRIYA and U_SOPHIE as members, is_private=false.
roles.reason: Same pattern: public channel containing both required members, does not satisfy privacy condition.

roles.facts: C06ALPHADEV (project-alpha-dev) has U_PRIYA as a member but no membership record for U_SOPHIE, and is_private=false.
roles.reason: Fails both conditions: missing Sophie's membership and not private, illustrating a split-condition failure.

roles.facts: Priya Sharma (U_PRIYA), member of core-infra, model-research, product-growth, frontend, project-alpha-dev, but never a member of any private/DM channel with Sophie.
roles.reason: Anchors one required membership condition along the route without independently resolving the conversation.

roles.facts: Sophie Dubois (U_SOPHIE), member of core-infra, model-research, product-growth, frontend, and the private dm-agent-sophie channel with the acting bot, but not with Priya.
roles.reason: Anchors the second required membership condition; her only private channel lacks Priya, which is what makes the conjunction unsatisfiable.

obligations.name: target_private_shared_channel
obligations.description: The single private conversation (is_private=true) that has both Priya Sharma and Sophie Dubois as conversation members, intended for archiving. No such conversation exists in the seeded data.
obligations.scope: private channel identified via conversation membership of two specific named people

task_spec.text: Find the private channel where both Priya and Sophie are members and archive it.

access_plan: Discover candidate private conversations via conversations.list with types=private_channel (and cross-check mpim/im kinds), then call conversations.members on each candidate to check for both Priya's and Sophie's user IDs; users.info/users.list resolve the two names to user IDs first. Enumerating this small set shows no private conversation contains both members, establishing the absent outcome before any archive call is attempted.
